message: On a Mac or a wide iPad window, quick add, menus and sheets stay a readable width instead of stretching across the window, and the undo bar and the add button's menu no longer land away from or on top of the button. Clicking a task now opens it in the pane beside the list, and the pane asks before it throws away edits. With a keyboard, the arrow keys move through your tasks: Return opens one, Space completes it, Delete removes it, ⌘A selects everything on screen, Escape steps back out, and ⌘Return saves or adds. Right-clicking a task now also offers Skip, Mark Missed, Duplicate and Copy Title.
